issue.title: Retire ace_unified_agents
issue.description: Show one unified Agents list across local and enrolled machines.

task_type_fields.remove_when: Remove this flag after the unified list, attention inbox, actions, launch experience, Machines pane, and live acceptance phases land with both-state coverage.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: ACE keeps the existing Focus and Fleet sub-tab experience unchanged.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: ACE shows one Agents list that includes local and enrolled-machine rows through the shared projection, with machine identity shown as row context.

payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE: just check is currently blocked at tools/check_feature_flags because live flag bead sase-z6 (key ace_unified_agents) has no registry definition. Reproduced 2026-09-11 in workspace verification for unrelated zero-usage top-bar presentation work after fmt, keep-sorted, ruff, and mypy passed: rule 8 reports 'live flag bead '\''sase-z6'\'' has no definition (key '\''ace_unified_agents'\'')'. The local diff touches usage indicator rendering, docs, and tests, not the feature flag registry or unified Agents implementation, so this belongs to the existing flag-retirement bead rather than a new CI task.
